facets.description: isAccessTokenId reads the grant shortcut with substring(3,5) instead of substring(4,6), so it gets the wrong characters (AssertEvents.java line 483)
isAccessTokenId has the equality check backwards: it returns no-match when the slice equals the expected shortcut, so the grant check never actually tests anything
isAccessTokenId has no length check on items[0], so a short prefix makes substring throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
